en.title: I Need Thee Every Hour
en.author: Annie S. Hawks
stanzas:
[G]I need Thee [D7]ev'ry [G]hour,
most [C]gracious [G]Lord;
no [C]tender [G]voice like [A7]Thine
can [D7]peace af[G]ford.

I need Thee ev'ry hour,
stay Thou nearby;
temptations lose their pow'r
when Thou art nigh.

I need Thee ev'ry hour,
in joy or pain;
come quickly and abide,
or life is vain.

I need Thee ev'ry hour,
teach me Thy will;
and Thy rich promises
in me fulfill.

I need Thee ev'ry hour,
most Holy One;
O make me Thine indeed,
Thou blessed Son.

notes: Text is hymnary.org's representative text (Our Great Redeemer's Praise #340); it prints the elisions ev'ry/pow'r. The refrain (words and music) was added by Robert Lowry, 1872. hymnary lists NEED (Lowry) in A-flat Major; G and A are equidistant, so G wins by the rule's preference order. Chords are a best-effort chart from the tune's incipit and standard harmonization, not verified bar-for-bar against a score.
